sources.label: Al Jazeera English live
sources.intent: Official, free-to-watch live news used as the rooftop's window into current reality.
sources.resolutionPolicy: Resolve through an official embed-capable Al Jazeera/YouTube surface at integration/runtime. Do not scrape, proxy, or rebroadcast raw HLS merely because the stream is free to watch.
sources.renderingPolicy: Cross-origin embed is an external-media layer aligned to the physical TV screen; it is not topology and need not be a WebGL VideoTexture.

activation.default: proximity after first player interaction; inaudible at distance
activation.instantiate: only when containing chunk is active and viewer is near/potentially sees screen

failure.fallback: physical TV remains; dark glass, subtle static, or NO SIGNAL; no retry storm

sources.determinism: World stores semantic source key only. Live pixels/audio are intentionally nondeterministic.

sources.label: DVIDS live roulette
sources.intent: Credential-free rotating DVIDS live webcast source for televisions and radio-audio spawn media.
sources.resolutionPolicy: Browser loads only the sanitized jweb-media-runtime bridge. GitHub Actions alone reads the DVIDS API using repository secret DVIDS_API_KEY; never commit or send that credential to a browser.
sources.renderingPolicy: Resolve as ordinary HLS through the shared screen/audio media runtime. DVIDS is a semantic source key, so any spawn composition may select it without DVIDS-specific geometry.

activation.default: proximity after first player interaction; inaudible at distance
activation.instantiate: only when containing chunk is active and viewer is near/potentially sees or hears the device

failure.fallback: physical TV/radio remains; NO SIGNAL or silence while no DVIDS event is playable; retry without affecting world generation

sources.determinism: World stores semantic source key only. The rotating live event is intentionally wall-clock/network dependent.
